newsitem.title: ITALY: Spread of BTP over Bund falls to record low.
newsitem.headline: Spread of BTP over Bund falls to record low.

text.p: The yield spread of the benchmark 10-year BTP over the benchmark Bund fell to a record low of 119 basis points in the European afternoon on Monday.

The February 2007 BTP was quoted 18 basis points higher on the day at 99.40 with a yield of 6.94 percent while the July 2007 Bund was trading down 18 basis points at 101.86 with a yield of 5.74 percent.
